reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26197398 (hash 0x6fd1992621fb11dd9599781da3964b4af01610ac03562cc0735ea6dd7cf9ad87, 2026-10-15T10:44:47Z), asset() is PYUSD; totalAssets=398852797264458, idle underlying=20952583445586 and sole adapter realAssets=377900213818872 in six-decimal PYUSD base units. Idle plus adapter assets reconcile exactly to totalAssets. The eight NAV-accounted lender positions have zero local borrow shares and zero posted collateral. Expected supply assets by borrower collateral: cbBTC=1702056124524, wstETH=110613783992, sUSDe=109518113581333, syrupUSDC=57990335836043, LBTC=2790743292, weETH=29787538551323, WBTC=1192648336206, kBTC=177596116862159. The largest borrower-collateral exposures are kBTC (44.5267% of total NAV), sUSDe (27.4583%) and syrupUSDC (14.5393%). These are PYUSD loans, not direct holdings of the posted collateral. The parent link denotes denomination and inherited token risk, not ownership of the parent issuer reserves. Current forceDeallocate calls Morpho.withdraw and charges 0.01% of assets deallocated; a direct in-kind lender-position transfer is not an entrypoint of this adapter.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Immediate lender positions are held in contracts and intentionally reused as loans. No whole-book claim of exclusively on-chain ultimate collateral custody is made. Parent issuer custody remains inherited; underlying collateral legal/custody layers and recoveries are unresolved. June 2026 Sentora terms section 4.3 describes non-custodial vault configurations; section 21.4 specifies BVI governing law and arbitration. This is an issuer legal statement, not evidence of borrower collateral segregation or removal of observed curator powers. Lending deployment is intentional strategy reuse; it does not establish custodians' contractual rights to repledge collateral, which remain unknown.
